question: Who became the first Indian woman to win a silver medal in the World Wrestling Championships in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anshu Malik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anshu Malik became the **first Indian woman wrestler** to win a silver medal at the World Wrestling Championships in **2021**.
 
• She competed in the **57 kg weight category** and advanced to the finals by defeating top opponents from across the globe.
 
• In the final, Anshu faced Olympic champion Helen Maroulis of the USA and secured the historic silver medal despite a tough match.
 
• Her achievement marked a significant milestone in Indian wrestling history, breaking barriers for women in the sport at an international level.
 
• Before this, Indian women wrestlers had only won bronze medals at the World Wrestling Championships, making her silver medal a groundbreaking success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Wrestling Championships:**

 
 
• An annual wrestling competition organized by United World Wrestling (UWW).
 
• It features freestyle, Greco-Roman, and women's wrestling categories.
 
• It is considered one of the most prestigious events in the sport of wrestling globally.
 
 
 
• **Helen Maroulis:**
 
 
• An American freestyle wrestler and Olympic champion.
 
• She became the first American woman to win a gold medal in wrestling at the 2016 Rio Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Indian Women in Wrestling:**
 
 
• Notable achievements include medals by Geeta Phogat, Babita Phogat, and Vinesh Phogat in international competitions.
 
• The rise of women wrestlers in India is attributed to grassroots initiatives and government support.
 
 
 
• **Anshu Malik's Background:**
 
 
• Born in Nidani, Haryana, a state known for producing top wrestlers.
 
• Trained under national coaches and received support from the Wrestling Federation of India (WFI).
